patch.value: project-watcher: bounded round-robin scan for projects beyond MAX_FILES_PER_PROJECT (8000)

Follow-up from PR #56 review (CodeRabbit, project-watcher.ts:34). safeWorkspaceSignature caps each per-tick scan at MAX_FILES_PER_PROJECT=8000 stat calls. For a single project with >8000 eligible files (~>4000 items, since each item = 1 .toon + 1 history/*.jsonl), files scanned after the cap can be missed indefinitely for out-of-band change detection. This is a deliberate backstop limitation: the primary realtime paths (pm-web API broadcasts + pg_notify from pm-gpt/pm-mcp) already cover normal writes; the watcher only backstops RAW direct writes to the shared volume that bypass BOTH, and only for projects large enough to exceed the cap. FIX (deferred): a bounded round-robin scan that advances a per-project cursor across ticks so every eligible file is eventually covered while preserving the per-tick I/O budget (cost scales with live viewership, not project size). Alternatively raise/env-tune the cap. Must not reintroduce recursive inotify or unbounded per-tick stat work.

Every eligible .toon/history file in a >8000-file project is eventually observed for out-of-band changes within a bounded number of ticks; per-tick stat work stays capped; no inotify; suppression + baseline semantics preserved; unit test covers a >cap project detecting a late-file change.

value.text: Implemented 2026-07-24 (PR: bounded round-robin sweep). computeWorkspaceSignature refactored to share a stable enumerateEligibleFiles() (names-only readdir, sorted, NO stat); added stepWorkspaceSweep(dir,state,maxFilesPerTick) that folds per-file fingerprints into (count,xor,sum) accumulators across ticks via a per-project cursor, only comparing/emitting when a full sweep completes. createProjectWatchCycle holds per-project WorkspaceSweepState; an injected readSignature is adapted to a one-tick sweep (existing tests + small projects unchanged). Per-tick stat I/O capped at maxFilesPerTick (env PM_WATCH_MAX_FILES_PER_TICK, default 8000); every file observed within ceil(total/cap) ticks. No inotify; suppression/baseline/consume-signal semantics preserved.

patch.value: stepWorkspaceSweep advances a per-project cursor across ticks, folding per-file path:mtime fingerprints into count/xor/sum accumulators; a full-workspace signature is only produced (and compared/emitted) when the sweep completes. Per-tick stat calls capped at maxFilesPerTick (PM_WATCH_MAX_FILES_PER_TICK, default 8000). Cost scales with live viewership, not project size.

Every eligible .toon/history file in a >8000-file project is eventually observed within bounded ticks; per-tick stat work capped; no inotify; suppression + baseline semantics preserved; unit test covers a >cap late-file change.

New test 'project watcher: >cap project detects a LATE-swept file change within bounded ticks, no spurious mid-sweep emit' (maxFilesPerTick=2, 5 files) passes; parity test confirms a within-cap sweep equals the one-shot signature; all 10 prior watcher tests unchanged; full suite 125/125 pass.
Bounded round-robin sweep implemented + unit-tested (>cap late-file detection).
